subcommittees.name: Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Applies to grant-receiving entities assisting the Secretary of Veterans Affairs with unclaimed or abandoned veteran remains.
dimensions.evidence: an entity in receipt of a grant under the Veterans Legacy Program may use such grant to assist the Secretary

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative and operational flexibility for specific grant recipients without altering broad rights.
dimensions.evidence: assist the Secretary of Veterans Affairs in locating unclaimed or abandoned human remains

dimensions.assessment: Explicitly prohibits requesting additional budget amounts beyond what is already intended for the program.
dimensions.evidence: shall not be requested in addition to amounts otherwise intended to be requested for the Veterans Legacy Program

dimensions.assessment: Temporarily amends authorized uses for a specific existing grant program.
dimensions.evidence: Notwithstanding section 1(a)(3) of Public Law 116-107... temporarily expand the authorized uses

dimensions.assessment: Lasts for a limited period ending on the last day of the second fiscal year beginning after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: ending on the last day of the second fiscal year beginning after such date

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts or estimates of the grants affected.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill temporarily expands the authorized uses of existing Veterans Legacy Program grants to help locate, identify, and inter unclaimed or abandoned veteran remains for a period of two fiscal years.

label: H.R. 9321

selection.reason: Impact scored by Gemini. (rated before the current eligibility rules; kept)

title: To temporarily expand the authorized uses of grants awarded under the Veterans Legacy Program of the National Cemetery Administration, and for other purposes.
